import time

async def worker():
    time.sleep(2)
    return "done"
prose_claim: While paused here, other pending tasks on the running loop keep making progress.
rationale: time.sleep blocks the whole thread and the event loop; only asyncio.sleep yields.

code:
import requests

resp = requests.get("https://api.example.com/data", retries=3)
print(resp.status_code)
prose_claim: Retries the request up to three times on connection failure.
rationale: requests.get forwards **kwargs to request(); retries is not an accepted kwarg — TypeError. Retries are configured via HTTPAdapter.
